method: Research-only rollout reranker: baseline native weighted choice plus up to two strongest native-pool alternatives. Two paired native continuations and three native strategy presets per candidate. Replace only for more training wins and nonworse worst gold. Full 24-turn paired drafts with per-turn seeded opponent draws; 16 separately seeded holdout strategy/eligible role/default purchase-order profiles. Default own items and native draft-fit own plan, not production strategy/item optimization. Related deterministic scenarios, not independent PvP matches. No production integration.
